policy.identity: machine + cu + component number; device_id only exact CU_LINK match

conclusions.comment: Actual and target component, port and edge records preserve source selectors; endpoints use component number plus port ordinal, never ordinal as identity.
CU_LINK is checked independently by exact device_id and reciprocal CU representations: cnc135=4, cnc152=1.
ARC is limited to station/slot presence; component, device_id and port are unavailable.
Saved v0.9.4 summary fields are compared independently for each machine.
No ARC/electrical observation creates or changes runtime edges.
